species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 63°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 18–32 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 63°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.

Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
